quote: ROHE reports two scores: acc and acc+.

ROHE reports two scores: acc and acc+. The acc score represents the proportion of correctly answered question in the positive VQA unit; while the acc+ score reflects the proportion of correctly answered question in both the positive VQA unit and negative VQA unit.
